notes: The page states 'Our Menu 100% free of gluten, dairy, soy, peanuts, refined sugar & seed oils.' That is an ingredient claim, not a statement about a dedicated kitchen, dedicated fryer, or celiac-safe handling, so the dishes are unclear for celiac (they are yes in kitava-mission-gluten-free). The oat-based Plant Protein Patty is left out on purpose because oats are contested for celiac.
